coordinate_system: Pixel coordinates are top-left positions in the supplied source image.
usage: Import individual PNGs as visual sprites. Build collision masks against the separate geometry master; alpha contours are not collision geometry.
limitations: Visible-pixel extraction from a flattened concept image. Covered/hidden sides of doors, crate, dinosaur and platforms cannot be recovered. A few terrain prefabs intentionally retain attached detail.
